item.rs_integration.resonance_storage_di: All things stored. Every power carried.
No need to hold them; countless relics and charms echo their power through the storage network.
Hold Sneak to view the resonance rules
Stored items count as carried, enabling passive effects and resource lookups.
Durability, data, and state changes are saved back to the disk.
Supports potion charms, mixed potion charms, the Infernal Tear, Quartz Flower, and Spectral Eye Amulet.
Also supports Nine Swords manuals, buff curios, and grouped infinite potions.
Powder Snow, Source, Venom, and Hot Spring buckets can be used in recursive crafting.
To gain Void Favor, throw the disk into the well;
or connect it to the network, carry a terminal, and jump into the well. This also unlocks special transmutations.
Only one Resonance Disk is active in each storage network.
